commit 817cbd7ad40b746900b15112fa1fd3ef10c37989
Author:     Max Emig <mozilla@emigm.ax>
AuthorDate: Tue May 5 08:06:16 2026 +0000
Commit:     Max Emig <mozilla@emigm.ax>
CommitDate: Tue May 5 08:06:16 2026 +0000

    Bug 1861800 - Treat bare "Content-Type: text" as text/plain in body search. r=mkmelin
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D298386

diff --git a/mailnews/search/src/nsMsgBodyHandler.cpp b/mailnews/search/src/nsMsgBodyHandler.cpp
index 367aa266a39..7b7e46b2757 100644
--- a/mailnews/search/src/nsMsgBodyHandler.cpp
+++ b/mailnews/search/src/nsMsgBodyHandler.cpp
@@ -798,9 +798,12 @@ void nsMsgBodyHandler::SniffPossibleMIMEHeader(const nsCString& line) {
       m_partIsPGP = false;
       // S/MIME is one monolithic base64-encoded blob with no boundaries.
       m_partIsSMIME = true;
-    } else if (lowerCaseLine.Find("text/") != kNotFound)
+    } else if (lowerCaseLine.Find("text/") != kNotFound ||
+               lowerCaseLine.Find("content-type: text") != kNotFound)
+      // Mirror handling elsewhere; bare "text" without subtype is invalid
+      // per RFC 2045 but treated as text/plain (mimei.cpp, mimedrft.cpp).
       m_partIsText = true;
-    else if (lowerCaseLine.Find("text/") == kNotFound)
+    else
       m_partIsText = false;  // We have disproven our assumption.
   }
 
diff --git a/mailnews/search/src/nsMsgBodyHandler2.cpp b/mailnews/search/src/nsMsgBodyHandler2.cpp
index 7dfd73401b3..18e6446be2c 100644
--- a/mailnews/search/src/nsMsgBodyHandler2.cpp
+++ b/mailnews/search/src/nsMsgBodyHandler2.cpp
@@ -269,9 +269,12 @@ void nsMsgBodyHandler2::SniffPossibleMIMEHeader(const nsCString& line) {
       m_partIsText =
           true;  // Default is text/plain, maybe proven otherwise later.
       m_inMessageAttachment = true;
-    } else if (lowerCaseLine.Find("text/") != kNotFound)
+    } else if (lowerCaseLine.Find("text/") != kNotFound ||
+               lowerCaseLine.Find("content-type: text") != kNotFound)
+      // Mirror handling elsewhere; bare "text" without subtype is invalid
+      // per RFC 2045 but treated as text/plain (mimei.cpp, mimedrft.cpp).
       m_partIsText = true;
-    else if (lowerCaseLine.Find("text/") == kNotFound)
+    else
       m_partIsText = false;  // We have disproven our assumption.
   }
 
diff --git a/mailnews/search/test/unit/test_searchBody.js b/mailnews/search/test/unit/test_searchBody.js
index 840fda38389..6a368eb6063 100644
--- a/mailnews/search/test/unit/test_searchBody.js
+++ b/mailnews/search/test/unit/test_searchBody.js
@@ -103,6 +103,10 @@ var Files = [
   // S/MIME encrypted message.
   "../../../../mail/test/browser/smime/data/alice.env.eml",
 
+  // Bare "Content-Type: text" and missing Content-Type.
+  "../../../data/bare-text-type.eml",
+  "../../../data/no-content-type.eml",
+
   // TODO: apparently search opaque does not work
   //"../../../../mail/test/browser/smime/data/alice.sig.SHA256.opaque.env.eml",
 ];
@@ -190,6 +194,10 @@ var Tests = [
   // Test for S/MIME encrypted messsage.
   { value: "This is a test message from Alice to Bob", Contains, count: 1 },
 
+  // Body search should find text in messages with bare "Content-Type: text"
+  // or no Content-Type header at all.
+  { value: "waldo", op: Contains, count: 2 },
+
   // Tests for HTML entities and style stripping.
 
   // 1. Test for Bug 999038: CSS style blocks should be skipped.
diff --git a/mailnews/test/data/bare-text-type.eml b/mailnews/test/data/bare-text-type.eml
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..8dccb0ac340
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mailnews/test/data/bare-text-type.eml
@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+From: sender@example.invalid
+To: recipient@example.invalid
+Subject: Message with content-type text
+Message-ID: <bare-text-type@example.invalid>
+Content-Type: text
+
+Try a Thunderbird Quick Filter for waldo in the message body.
diff --git a/mailnews/test/data/no-content-type.eml b/mailnews/test/data/no-content-type.eml
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..a5e0408982c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mailnews/test/data/no-content-type.eml
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+From: sender@example.invalid
+To: recipient@example.invalid
+Subject: Message with no content-type in header
+Message-ID: <no-content-type@example.invalid>
+
+Try a Thunderbird Quick Filter for waldo in the message body.
